points.description: States the circumstance: multiple hidden layers are desirable when the problem requires deep learning or learning of complex/hierarchical features (i.e. a task too complex for a single hidden layer). Equivalent wording such as 'when feature learning is critical' or 'when the data has complex patterns needing deep features' earns the mark.

States the reason: the extra hidden layers extract and learn the features properly and efficiently so the network can perform its task well. Equivalent wording such as 'the layers learn increasingly abstract features, enabling good performance' earns the mark. Examples given (multiclass classification, XOR) are illustrations only and are not required for this mark.
